_v1_notes.CONTEXT|AID MODALITY: water and sanitation infrastructure is N in an active conflict zone (works cannot be built and held) and N in a dispersed famine area (no fixed population to serve). Cash transfer is N in a famine remote area, where absent markets make cash worthless.
_v1_notes.CONTEXT|DELIVERY CHANNEL: host government ministry is N in an active conflict zone, where the state is a party. Military logistics is N in a protracted refugee settlement and N in a famine area - neither warrants the neutrality cost.
_v1_notes.CONTEXT|PRIMARY CONSTRAINT: post-earthquake urban is N for access denial by armed actors and N for absent markets. A protracted settlement is N for all three physical constraints, being stable and served - only funding shortfall applies.
_v1_notes.CONTEXT|DURATION: post-earthquake is N at years as posed. A protracted settlement is N at weeks by definition.
_v1_notes.AID MODALITY|DELIVERY CHANNEL: cash transfer and water infrastructure are both N via military logistics - neither is a military task.
_v1_notes.AID MODALITY|PRIMARY CONSTRAINT: cash transfer is N under absent functioning markets, which is exactly what makes cash useless.
_v1_notes.AID MODALITY|DURATION: medical field hospital and water infrastructure are both N at weeks - neither is established in that time.
_v1_notes.DELIVERY CHANNEL|PRIMARY CONSTRAINT: host government ministry is N under access denied by armed actors, since that denial is precisely of state reach.
_v1_notes.DELIVERY CHANNEL|DURATION: military logistics is N at years - it is a surge capability, not a standing arrangement.
